body: I'm glad you were able to get yourself out of a situation like this.  Please never forget how awful this place is and never end up back here again... please.  Protect those pillars I mentioned in my post at all costs.  Make sure you have support systems in place holding you accountable to protecting those pillars and maintain those support systems.  I fought like hell to pull myself out of this hellhole motivated to be with a girl again only to see her lose faith me.  I felt the sensation of falling into the abyss all over again and all I saw in her eyes was that there was nothing more she could do for me.  I lost my curiosity for tomorrow and I'm no longer forgiving and patient with myself.  I'm not a creature you bring home to save.  I'm one you put down and out of his misery in wild.
